name: price-watcher
title: Price Watcher
description: Track product prices on any e-commerce site - including JavaScript-rendered storefronts behind bot protection. Uses schema.org/Product structured data first, heuristic extraction as fallback, and SimHash change detection between runs.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Price Watcher
input.description: Track product prices on any e-commerce site - including JavaScript-rendered storefronts behind bot protection. Uses schema.org/Product structured data first, heuristic extraction as fallback, and SimHash change detection between runs.

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

currency_hint.title: Currency hint
currency_hint.description: Expected ISO currency code for price normalization.

extract_image.title: Include product image URL
extract_image.description: Capture the primary product image when present.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
